assertions.name: stateful flag in topology
assertions.detail: POST /api/nodes/spawn with stateful:true → topology shows stateful:true for mesh1.broker.7f0e1b

assertions.name: NodeId preserved across restart
assertions.detail: before restart node_id=7f0e1b02648447b9d900c6e1e245b2e333e0ad23a37000b82633fc5fcfb3f41d, after restart same node_id in topology response

assertions.name: data dir intact after restart

assertions.name: rafka.ui.node.restart span in Jaeger
assertions.span_log_event: stateful node restarted with same identity
